name: What factors influence the cost of building a one-bedroom ADU?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of building a one-bedroom ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a one-bedroom ADU is influenced by several factors, including the unit's size, chosen materials, site preparation requirements, and internal finishes. For example, a detached ADU might require more extensive foundation and utility trenching than a garage conversion. Customers should consider their budget against desired features like high-end appliances or custom cabinetry, as these choices directly impact the final project cost. We provide detailed estimates to help you understand these tradeoffs.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU costs are affected by size, materials, site work, and finishes; detached units often cost more due to foundation and utility needs.
